description:
COSTS MONEY: Top up the balance

Charges one of your stored cards right away and adds the amount to your prepaid euro balance; this cannot be undone over the API. `amountEur` is net: the balance carries no VAT, VAT is charged when the balance is used. The balance pays for orders placed with `place_order` and payment method `balance`. To buy a plan or add-on directly use `place_order`; for automatic refills of minutes and conversations use `set_auto_topup`. `paymentMethodId` is an `id` from `list_payment_methods`. Refused with 400 when the card holder has to confirm the payment (top up in the dashboard then), when top ups are not available for your account or when the payment fails. Returns the new balance.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: deposit_balance
